exposure: Country of origin (El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras)
outcome: Beliefs and concerns about gestational weight gain (GWG)
Receipt of advice from healthcare providers regarding GWG
Sources of information for healthy weight management during pregnancy
cohort: 93 pregnant immigrant women from El Salvador, Guatemala, and Honduras living in the United States, most of whom were married and had household incomes below $40,000.
finding: Beliefs about gestational weight gain (GWG) and the receipt of weight gain recommendations from healthcare providers varied significantly among pregnant Central American immigrant women based on their country of origin.
